wire.scope: domain organization/company/branch UUIDs assigned by explicit protected provisioning
wire.nativeScope: internal authenticated/resolved sourceNamespace + original string organization/company/branch IDs
wire.genericAccess: all branch_pos namespace models remain denied even to generic administrators/server keys

identityRequirements: Qualify native identity by entity kind and source/environment namespace.
Enforce bidirectional uniqueness for each organization mapping, company mapping under its organization, and branch mapping under its company.
A unique full scope triple alone is insufficient: the same domain parent must not resolve to different native parents across child rows.
Verify the actual native Org -> Company -> Branch parent links and corresponding domain links in the same admission snapshot.
Identity mappings are immutable. Deactivation retains tombstones; no identifier reuse/re-pointing that would reinterpret historical signed evidence.
No hashing/casting legacy native IDs into UUIDs or ObjectIDs; no implicit allocation, auto-creation or mapping repair during ingestion.
transactionRequirements: AuthorizeUploader validates current source/native-scope enrollment and revocation, not request-supplied roles.
ResolveOrigin resolves the domain scope, checks missing/ambiguous/disabled/reparented mappings, verifies native hierarchy, and returns authoritative NativeScope.
Ingest compares the resolved source/native scope to Principal.NativeScope before signature/receipt lookup/persistence.
All historic actor/resource/unit/SKU/scale/key/master/authority/config references must belong to the same admitted scope.
Receipt replay uses the same mapping/authentication admission; existing receipts do not bypass current device/mapping status.

localEvidence.positiveCase: Identical native text IDs in independent source namespaces do not become reverse aliases when domain identities are distinct.
localEvidence.limitation: Explicit private fixture registry models the REQUIRED interface behavior. It does not prove a Mongo mapping implementation, installed indexes, or producer enrollment.

storageDecision: Current seven-model generation probe is not this registry. Select/generate the additional mapping persistence schema and unique indexes under separate review before runtime ingestion.
